nativeDecisions.equations: A y=x²+4; B y=x²+x; C y=x²−5; D y=7x−3. Exponents bind lower y-offset/smaller font source runs, not plain extracted x2.
nativeDecisions.feedback: Seven branch domains. Count increments on wrong click; Tryagain only for count1. Exact Close hold/exit windows and second-error continuation.
nativeDecisions.audio: Eight source MP3 domains decoded 22050Hz mono; SA48000Hz mono. No listening or alignment acceptance.
nativeDecisions.layout: Single-column source A/B/C/D order; source alpha respected. D compacts when other rows disappear; source pixel translation is not recreated. Original magenta flashing becomes continuous high-contrast term emphasis during each source burst window, with exact raw overlay frames retained separately.
